description: Use this when the user asks to design, mock up, wireframe or lay out a user interface or a page as an editable design: a website, landing or pricing page, an app screen (login, settings, checkout), a dashboard, a slide, a social post, a poster, an invitation, a menu or a business card, or a design to edit or tweak by hand. It opens a new, empty, live Brilliant canvas in the chat; the design is built there as editable layers (frames, text, shapes, icons). Not for generating a photograph or an illustration, for photo edits (use remove_background) or for questions that need no design. Do not use to change a design already open in this conversation. Rows take literal values (hex colors, numbers); design tokens are not available in this lane.

intent.description: One plain line on what this design is about to hold, such as "A pricing section with three plans and a highlighted middle tier". The canvas shows it beside ChatGPT's cursor while the first rows are written.

title.description: A short name for the design.

name: design
title: Design on a Brilliant canvas
